item.title: GovBrief Today #626
item.description: Emiliano Andrade-Covarrubias had his medicine with him when he was detained, but his daughter says the staff at his ICE jail wouldn’t give it to him. The Dallas painter was jailed in June. Guards found him dead in his Laredo cell Saturday morning. His family learned of his death from the county medical examiner, because nobody from ICE called them. Emiliano told his family his chest felt tight and he was having trouble breathing. He said the medical staff “would just ignore him.” ICE’s own detention rules say the people it holds shall receive continuity of care. On Monday his daughter, an American citizen, goes to the jail to collect his personal effects. I’ve emailed 9,572 stories over 626 straight nights, free and without ads. item.title: About to present my stuff at MCM Comic Con...
item.description:
I spent a lot of time getting rejection letters from agents and editors, posting the occasional thing online, never had much success. In 2021, I self-published my first book, and it took off. It took off enough that now, five years later, I can actually afford to be an exhibitor at the biggest comic con in the UK. I am also extremely nervous about this.
I got accepted to exhibit in the "Writer's Block" section of the con, with a few other indie authors. There will also be some pretty famous people as official guests in the area: Rick Riordan, V.E. Schwab, Veronica Roth, Paul Tremblay, Travis Baldree, and a bunch of other folks. I'm still pretty small time, but it's really cool being a part of this. And, again, very nerve-wracking. If you're in the UK, and you're going to the Con, PLEASE stop by and say hello! It'd be pretty cool to meet some other imgurians out in the wild. I'm at table WB-28. I'll be selling signed copies and giving away some free goodies. https://www.mcmcomiccon.com/london/en-us/things-to-do/Writers-Block.html
I first posted about my writing here on imgur in January of 2023, a few months after my first book launched. The support people showed me then and in the years since has been very humbling, flattering, and much appreciated. I'm only able to qualify for the con and afford the expenses because of communities like this. Special shout out to @LincLoud , @WhatDeanerWasTalkingAbout , @Xenoti , @Tyrrlin , @nichoDriver , and @godlikescoke .
If you've made it this far down the post, thanks to you too. If a book series about a 7-foot-tall muscle woman doing fire-enhanced pro-wrestling moves on Lovecraftian aliens sounds fun, maybe give my books a shot.
